item.title: Tariff hikes power MTN Nigeria to ₦5.2 trillion record revenue
item.description: MTN Nigeria, the country’s largest telecom operator, generated more revenue in 2025 reported ₦5.20 trillion ($3.82 billion) in revenue for the year, according to its full-year financial results. This is the highest ever recorded in Nigeria’s telecom sector, up from ₦3.36 trillion ($2.47 billion) in 2024.

item.title: MTN Nigeria nearly doubles staff earning ₦2.4 million monthly in 2025
item.description: According to its full-year financial report released on Thursday, the number of staff in the highest salary band rose to 659 in 2025, a 97.3% increase from a year earlier.

item.title: CcHUB EdTech Fellowship returns with $100,000 equity-free funding
item.description: Co-creation HUB (CcHUB) has opened applications for Cohort 4 of its EdTech Fellowship, where 12 early-stage startups building edtech platforms will be able to receive $100,000.

item.title: Luno Nigeria to offer derivates in ‘all-in-one’ investment strategy push
item.description: Luno plans to introduce financial contracts that let traders speculate on the future price of an asset without owning it directly in 2026.

item.title: Kenya records 4.5 billion cyber threats as digital risks mount
item.description: A new report by cybersecurity firm SmartComply, released in Nairobi on Thursday, argues that cyber risk in the region has moved beyond IT departments and into the core of economic stability.

item.title: This startup is moving Nigeria’s land records to the blockchain
item.description: Sytemap digitises real estate records on the blockchain and connect them into a single mapped system to reduce fraud and double allocation.

item.description: The model combines self-paced online courses with mentorship, volunteering and community projects to build practical experience and employability.
